text.tspan: Physical AI: a robot-learning loop versus a video-generation model
DayDreamer closes the loop through a real robot.
DayDreamer · separate the physical interaction loop from model and behavior learning.

g.title: DayDreamer closes the loop through a real robot.
g.desc: DayDreamer · separate the physical interaction loop from model and behavior learning. Robot observations update the latent state. The actor selects a command, which changes the physical environment and produces the next observation. Recorded interaction trains the world model: recurrent dynamics and observation/reward/continuation predictions. Imagined trajectories train actor and critic. Updated actor parameters return to the robot interaction loop. Dashed connections denote the actuator loop and an actor-parameter update. This is the DayDreamer learning architecture; the body-specific sensor and actuator interfaces vary by experiment.

text.tspan: Dashed connections denote the actuator loop and an actor-parameter update. This is the DayDreamer learning architecture; the
body-specific sensor and actuator interfaces vary by experiment.
Cosmos-Predict2.5 generates video by integrating a flow.
Cosmos-Predict2.5/base · text and visual context condition a video diffusion Transformer trained with flow matching.

g.title: Cosmos-Predict2.5 generates video by integrating a flow.
g.desc: Cosmos-Predict2.5/base · text and visual context condition a video diffusion Transformer trained with flow matching. Clean reference latents replace the initial noisy frames with a condition mask. Text supplies cross-attention; time conditions adaptive normalization. The DiT predicts a velocity field on noisy video latents. Repeated integration steps move toward a generated latent video. The video tokenizer’s decoder turns the final latent into frames. A downstream controller or evaluator is a separate system. This is the base Predict2.5 generation path, not Cosmos 3 or a robot actuator policy. Wan2.1 VAE compression is 4×8×8 in time/height/width; latent patches are 1×2×2. Fields and frames are illustrative. Text encoder internals and solver choices are omitted.

text.tspan: Training: regress a target flow velocity at sampled interpolation times
